findings.title: Effective verdict is read from an unbound, mutable reviewer_result.txt; a lingering worker child can turn a genuine REJECT into ACCEPT and verify() stays clean
Malformed findings (dict, strings, scalar) are silently dropped and yield ACCEPT
Gate-finding regression proof skips class-based pytest ids and Flutter ids (earlier R5 finding still unrepaired)
Git hooks/config/info tamper detection is not anchored: a change caught once becomes the new baseline, and the diagnosis worker is never checked
Tests that passed on the baseline but are skipped on the candidate are not flagged by the gate comparison
Implicitly blocking MEDIUM findings are excluded from attempt counting and from the next round's prior-findings list
A gate failing only through 'vanished' tests is routed to FIXING with an empty findings list
binary_is_default is tautological for real milestones; a PATH shim named claude counts as the installed CLI
Stale or over-stated doc statements
PLAN-anchored GIT_CONTROL digest hashes the whole shared .git/config, so routine branch/tracking writes by other sessions block the milestone as TAMPER
Hashes compare text-mode writes with bytes read back: on Windows every round fails verify (fails closed)
Config allowlist added in 39ed499 hides worker-written remote.*.fetch refspecs, which the driver's integration fetch then uses to force-overwrite other local branches of the main repository
URI_DEVELOPMENT_LIFECYCLE.md still states that any hooks/config/info change is tamper, but 39ed499 ignores branch.* and remote fetch/prune/mirror keys

Git control-state tamper check covers only the repository config; worker-written user-level git config (~/.gitconfig) silently redirects the driver's push and its push verification, and smudge filters make reviewer/gate checkouts differ from the candidate commit
A REJECT result with a non-string finding title crashes the driver (uncaught AttributeError) instead of routing to repair
Limits section still calls max_rounds the hard bound although L-AC22 replaced it

Merge-mode integration runs candidate gate code after the last control-drift check; a test that writes ~/.gitconfig insteadOf redirects the push and its ls-remote verification, yielding a false COMPLETE
Contents of files included from the repository config (include.path / includeIf) are not bound by git_control_digest
URI_DEVELOPMENT_LIFECYCLE.md §6 still names `max_rounds` as the hard bound

Reviewer executable identity is not anchored: any 'claude' earlier on PATH (e.g. planted in ~/.local/bin by an implementer or gate test) counts as the installed CLI and its scripted ACCEPT makes a real milestone VERIFIED

The independent reviewer starts in the candidate checkout and loads the candidate's CLAUDE.md, .claude settings and skills as authoritative project instructions, so implementer-authored text reaches the reviewer outside the driver-built prompt
Docs claim every external command has a timeout and that max_rounds is the hard bound; driver git network commands have no timeout and limits.max_rounds is now refused

Reviewer still loads worker-writable user-level Claude settings (~/.claude/settings.json); an implementer-written env.ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL routes the genuine, PLAN-anchored claude binary to a scripted endpoint whose ACCEPT counts as an independent review of a real milestone

R7-01 config isolation is a post-run end-state check: a lingering setsid worker child injects env.ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL into the fresh reviewer CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, removes it after CLI startup, and the scripted ACCEPT is recorded with config_isolated=true
Timeout path calls communicate() without a timeout before the R8-01 orphan sweep: a setsid descendant holding stdout hangs the driver indefinitely and the sweep is never reached

contained=true is recorded although workers or orphans of an earlier, killed driver process are still running (outside the subreaper tree); documented limitation, but realistic and reachable through R10-01
